answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 31153 Country: India Title: I am one sister and have two brothers, both NRIs.my father has a huge flat in the most upcoming localities of Mumbai. Question: I am one sister and have two brothers, both NRIs.my father has a huge flat in the most upcoming localities of Mumbai.It was paid in terms of 'pagdi',where my father had paid a handsome amount and my father had been paying rent as my brothers were NRIs.After my fathers death my brothers say i have no right on it as a daughter as the house was rental.The market value of the house is in crores.Kindly enlighten me on this issue as per the shariat law. Answer ID: 31153 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 593/593/M=1432) If the said flat was the property of deceased father, then both the brothers and sister shall have their shares in it. The brothers are wrong who said to their sisters that they had no right. And, if the house was on rent and was not the property of the deceased father, then no one amongst the brothers and sister will have any share in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
